post.news: US safety regulators proposed using cyan lights to signal when a vehicle is operating autonomously without a human monitoring the road.
post.take: Finally, a giant neon sign telling you the car driving itself is about to make your insurance rates jump.
post.insight: As autonomous vehicles take over our roads, regulators are scrambling for standard ways to signal safety and automation to the public.
